csv.datetime: ISO 8601; server times without invented offset; verified UTC times end with Z

indicator_definitions.ema: EMA of close; alpha=2/(n+1); seed is SMA of first n valid chronological closes. Version changes require regeneration.
indicator_definitions.rsi: Wilder RSI(14), seed mean gains/losses of first 14 changes; both averages zero =>50; zero losses and positive gains =>100.
indicator_definitions.atr: Wilder ATR(14): TR=max(high-low,abs(high-prev_close),abs(low-prev_close)); initial ATR is mean of first 14 valid TRs.
indicator_definitions.warmup: Compute on prior continuous source history, not only exported event window. Prefer full prior history; minimum 1000 completed bars for exported EMA200 features; flags remain invalid when unavailable.

fields.name: rsi_14

fields.meaning: Data eligibility for the intended training task.

fields.name: quality_notes
fields.meaning: Specific missing data, ambiguity or exclusions.

fields.name: news_context_status
fields.meaning: Do not infer absence of news from missing historical calendar data.

fields.name: minutes_to_next_scheduled_high_impact_event
fields.meaning: Only historical scheduled information known at decision time; never released actual/surprise data.

fields.name: event_id
fields.meaning: Unique across broker, source symbol, decision time and setup sequence.

fields.name: plan_id
fields.meaning: One primary entry/exit policy per event in v1.

fields.name: entry_rule_version
fields.meaning: Versioned executable entry rule or draft_manual.

fields.name: exit_rule_version
fields.meaning: Versioned exit rule including priority and time stop.

fields.name: plan_status
fields.meaning: A complete trade has explicit executable entry, SL, TP and time/cancel rules.

fields.name: side
fields.meaning: Planned side for supervised training.

fields.name: entry_order_type
fields.meaning: Market orders use first eligible executable quote after decision; never guaranteed signal close fills.

fields.name: trigger_time_server
fields.meaning: Time at which entry trigger became observable, no later than decision.

fields.name: entry_reference_price
fields.meaning: Known decision-time order level/reference; next market fill remains unknown.

fields.name: entry_price_basis
fields.meaning: Buy opens at Ask; sell opens at Bid in quote-based simulation.

fields.name: entry_condition
fields.meaning: Precise observable trigger, linked to known level IDs.

fields.name: entry_expiry_server
fields.meaning: Unfilled entry becomes canceled after this time.

fields.name: cancel_condition
fields.meaning: Pre-entry invalidation rule, including structure failure and data/quote constraints.

fields.name: max_spread_points
fields.meaning: Decision/order-time spread constraint, versioned before evaluation.

fields.name: stop_loss_price
fields.meaning: Initial executable stop level; must be valid for planned side.

fields.name: stop_basis_level_id
fields.meaning: Confirmed structure level that fixes invalidation, if used.

fields.name: stop_buffer_points
fields.meaning: Explicit buffer in broker points, fixed from pre-entry policy.

fields.name: take_profit_price
fields.meaning: Primary pre-entry target; no future swing-extreme chosen after the fact.

fields.name: target_basis_level_id
fields.meaning: Previously known opposing structure level, if used.

fields.name: target_policy
fields.meaning: Exact target method. Any fixed distance/ATR multiplier is specified here.

fields.name: max_hold_seconds
fields.meaning: Time stop measured from actual fill.

fields.name: early_exit_condition
fields.meaning: Observable early invalidation or none.

fields.name: trailing_policy
fields.meaning: none in v1 unless a fully specified rule is registered.

fields.name: breakeven_policy
fields.meaning: none in v1 unless a fully specified rule is registered.

fields.name: estimated_commission_pips_roundtrip
fields.meaning: Known broker commission estimate converted to pips, not assumed zero.

fields.name: slippage_assumption_points
fields.meaning: Scenario assumption, not historical observed slippage.

fields.name: execution_delay_ms
fields.meaning: Explicit backtest delay assumption.

fields.name: event_id
fields.meaning: Unique across broker, source symbol, decision time and setup sequence.

fields.name: level_id
fields.meaning: Unique within event; includes latest/previous confirmed swings, signal extremes, observed pullback extremes and derived targets. Referenced by plan.csv.

fields.name: timeframe
fields.meaning: Origin timeframe. D1 is allowed only for known previous-day levels.

fields.name: level_type
fields.meaning: Price-action structure known by cutoff.

fields.name: price_low
fields.meaning: Lower edge of price level/zone.

fields.name: price_high
fields.meaning: Upper edge; equals price_low for a point level.

fields.name: origin_time_server
fields.meaning: Origin bar or start of underlying structure.

fields.name: known_at_server
fields.meaning: Earliest time at which confirmation was possible. Must be <= decision.

fields.name: detection_rule_version
fields.meaning: Exact swing/zone algorithm version.

fields.name: left_bars
fields.meaning: Swing parameter, if applicable.

fields.name: right_confirmation_bars
fields.meaning: Right-hand confirming bars already closed by known_at; never use them earlier.

fields.name: touch_count_asof
fields.meaning: Number of contacts known by cutoff.

fields.name: status_asof
fields.meaning: Level state using only observations by cutoff.

fields.name: event_id
fields.meaning: Unique across broker, source symbol, decision time and setup sequence.

fields.name: plan_id
fields.meaning: Matches the versioned primary plan.

fields.name: outcome_source
fields.meaning: Do not describe simulated fills as real trades.

fields.name: label_status
fields.meaning: No forced win/loss when path or horizon is unresolved.

fields.name: entry_fill_time_server
fields.meaning: Minute-bar boundary proxy for the simulated execution interval; not an observed exact tick timestamp. See execution_time_resolution and interval_end fields.

fields.name: entry_fill_price
fields.meaning: Executable fill including modeled slippage when applicable.

fields.name: exit_time_server
fields.meaning: Minute-bar boundary proxy for the simulated execution interval; not an observed exact tick timestamp. See execution_time_resolution and interval_end fields.

fields.name: exit_fill_price
fields.meaning: Buy liquidates on Bid; sell on Ask, subject to execution model.

fields.name: exit_reason
fields.meaning: Terminal event under the registered exit policy.

fields.name: holding_seconds
fields.meaning: Elapsed seconds between simulated minute-bar boundary proxies; approximate, not an observed tick holding duration.

fields.name: initial_risk_pips
fields.meaning: abs(entry_fill_price-initial_stop_loss_price)/pip_size, fixed at fill.

fields.name: gross_pnl_pips
fields.meaning: side_sign*(exit_fill_price-entry_fill_price)/pip_size. Bid/Ask spread and fill slippage already embedded.

fields.name: commission_pips_roundtrip
fields.meaning: Additional round-trip commission in pips; blank if not established.

fields.name: financing_cost_pips
fields.meaning: Additional financing cost in pips; positive costs reduce net, negative credits increase net.

fields.name: net_pnl_pips
fields.meaning: gross_pnl_pips-commission_pips_roundtrip-financing_cost_pips. Do not subtract spread/slippage a second time.

fields.name: net_r
fields.meaning: net_pnl_pips/initial_risk_pips; blank if costs or risk missing.

fields.name: mfe_pips
fields.meaning: Maximum nonnegative favorable executable liquidation excursion from fill until exit.

fields.name: mae_pips
fields.meaning: Maximum nonnegative adverse executable liquidation excursion from fill until exit.

fields.name: mfe_r
fields.meaning: mfe_pips/initial_risk_pips.

fields.name: mae_r
fields.meaning: mae_pips/initial_risk_pips.

fields.name: same_bar_sl_tp
fields.meaning: 1 if M1 bar data alone permits both SL and TP; tick order required to resolve.

fields.name: real_tick_coverage_ratio
fields.meaning: Measured coverage of required tradable minutes by real ticks, with denominator defined in config.

fields.name: label_end_time_server
fields.meaning: End of observed outcome or censoring horizon, used for purging.

fields.name: evaluation_rule_version
fields.meaning: Exact simulator/execution and label implementation version.

fields.name: gross_r
fields.meaning: Gross executable-price P&L / initial risk. No commission or measured slippage deduction.

fields.name: execution_model
fields.meaning: Explicit bar simulation assumptions; not actual trades.

fields.name: commission_status
fields.meaning: Historical round-trip commission has not been established.

fields.name: slippage_status
fields.meaning: Actual slippage was not collected.

fields.name: ticks_status
fields.meaning: Real tick history was not requested for this collection.

fields.name: execution_time_resolution
fields.meaning: Fill/exit time is a minute interval boundary proxy, not an observed exact tick.

fields.name: entry_interval_end_server
fields.meaning: Exclusive end of the minute within which the simulated entry happened.

fields.name: exit_interval_end_server
fields.meaning: Exclusive end of exit interval, or the boundary used for a time stop.

fields.name: entry_exit_same_bar_ambiguous
fields.meaning: Entry and possible exit share a candle and order cannot be resolved.

fields.meaning: Native MT5 tick time_msc preserved without reinterpretation.
